dek: Three days after a user teased Zhipu AI chief scientist Tang Jie on X about GLM-5.3, he replied 'sooooooon', and hours later the model was live. Focused solely on coding and security, GLM-5.3 more than doubled SWE-Marathon to 42.5, quintupled Terminal Bench 3.0 to 28.3, and scored 84.5 on CyberGym, first among all mode
